```{r setup environment, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

helper_candidates <- c(
  file.path(getwd(), "helpers_workflow.R"),
  system.file("scripts", "helpers_workflow.R", package = "metpipe")
)
helper_candidates <- helper_candidates[file.exists(helper_candidates)]
if (length(helper_candidates) == 0) {
  stop("Cannot locate shared helper script helpers_workflow.R")
}
source(helper_candidates[[1]], local = TRUE)

metpipe_runtime <- wf_load_metpipe_runtime()

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,
  include = TRUE
  )

```


```{r global input}

path_raw = params$path_raw
path_result = params$path_result
qc_types = params$qc_types
batch_size = as.numeric(params$batch_size)

path_raw <- wf_require_path(path_raw, "path_raw")

if (wf_is_blank(path_result)) stop("path_result is required")
path_result <- normalizePath(path_result, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)

```

```{r map raw data files to meta}

path_files_pos <- paste0(path_raw, "/pos/")
path_files_neg <- paste0(path_raw, "/neg/")

run.pos <- FALSE
run.neg <- FALSE
raw_files_pos <- NULL
raw_files_neg <- NULL
meta_pos <- NULL
meta_neg <- NULL

if (dir.exists(path_files_pos)){
  raw_files_pos <- sort(list.files(path_files_pos, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.(d|mzML|raw)$", ignore.case = TRUE))
  run.pos <- length(raw_files_pos) > 0
}

if (run.pos) {
  meta_pos <- 
    map_name_to_meta(raw_files_pos,
                      qc_types = qc_types,
                      batch_size = batch_size) 
}

if (dir.exists(path_files_neg)){
  raw_files_neg <- sort(list.files(path_files_neg, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.(d|mzML|raw)$", ignore.case = TRUE))
  run.neg <- length(raw_files_neg) > 0
}

if (run.neg) {
  meta_neg <- 
    map_name_to_meta(raw_files_neg,
                      qc_types = qc_types,
                      batch_size = batch_size) 
}

if (!run.pos && !run.neg) {
  stop("No raw files found in pos/ or neg/ under path_raw: ", path_raw)
}

```

```{r write metadata output excel}

wb <- createWorkbook()
if (run.pos) {
  addWorksheet(wb, "pos")
  writeData(wb, "pos", meta_pos)
}

if (run.neg) {
  addWorksheet(wb, "neg")
  writeData(wb, "neg", meta_neg)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, paste0(path_result, "/metadata_raw.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
